name: Best Power Ups (MIB)
description: Auto-compiled with libsmi from 1 MIB module(s). 151 readable OIDs under 1.3.6.1.4.1.2947.

oids.name: upsIdentUpsName
oids.description: An ID string identifying the Family of UPS.

oids.name: upsIdentModel
oids.description: The UPS model name (example: 'FE500VA').

oids.name: upsIdentVARating
oids.description: The capacity rating of the UPS expressed in VoltAmperes(VA).

oids.name: upsIdentUpsSerialNumber
oids.description: A unique identification number provided by the factory.

oids.name: upsIdentFirmwareRevision
oids.description: The firmware revision of the UPS.

oids.name: upsIdentInstallationDate
oids.description: The date when the UPS was installed in mm/dd/yyyy format.

oids.name: upsBatteryStatus
oids.description: The status of the inverter .

oids.name: upsBatteryTimeOnBattery
oids.description: The elapsed time in seconds since the UPS has switched to battery power.

oids.name: upsBatteryRuntimeRemaining
oids.description: The remaining time in minutes that the UPS will be able to run on battery power.

oids.name: upsBatteryVoltage
oids.description: The UPS battery voltage expressed in 1/10 VDC.

oids.name: upsBatteryCurrent
oids.description: The battery current expressed in 1/10 ADC.

oids.name: upsBatteryTemperature
oids.description: The internal UPS temperature expressed in 1/10 degree C.

oids.name: upsBatteryLastReplaceDate
oids.description: The date when the UPS system's batteries were last replaced in mm/dd/yyyy format. When the UPS batteries are replaced, this value should be reset by the administrator.

oids.name: upsBatteryCellVoltage
oids.description: The UPS battery cell voltage expressed in 1/100 VDC.

oids.name: upsBatteryPositiveVoltage
oids.description: The UPS battery voltage measured from the most postive point in the battery string to the common reference point. The value is expressed in 1/10 VDC.

oids.name: upsBatteryNegativeVoltage
oids.description: The UPS battery voltage measured from the most negative point in the battery string to the common reference point. The value is expressed in 1/10 VDC.

oids.name: upsInputFrequency
oids.description: The utility line frequency in 1/10 Hz.

oids.name: upsConfigDelayBeforeShutdown
oids.description: The delay in seconds that the UPS waits before executing an off command upon request of an external device.

oids.name: upsConfigTestScheduleIndex
oids.description: The index of scheduled events.

oids.description: The weekday on which the UPS should shut down.

oids.name: upsConfigTestScheduleTime
oids.description: The time that the process of shutting down the UPS will be initiated

oids.description: The index of scheduled events.

oids.description: The weekday on which the UPS should restart

oids.name: bestLinkHistoryLogFrequency
oids.description: The frequency of updating the history log in minutes.

oids.name: bestLinkRefreshFrequency
oids.description: The frequency of saving configuration,history and event log data in non-volatile memory. If the value is set to 0, then saving data is disabled.

oids.name: bestLinkNetId
oids.description: The IP address of the device. Setting this parameter causes BestLink to reboot.

oids.name: bestLinkGateway
oids.description: The gateway address for the network BestLink is connected to.

oids.name: bestLinkNetMask
oids.description: The net mask of the device.

oids.name: bestLinkSysDate
oids.description: The system date of the device. The date is in mm/dd/yyyy format. The range of system date is from 1/1/1980 to 12/31/2037.

oids.name: bestLinkSysTime
oids.description: The system time of the device. The time is in hh:mm:ss format.

oids.name: bestLinkTftpFileName
oids.description: The tftp file name that contains the software upgrade image.

oids.name: bestLinkTftpHost
oids.description: The tftp host IP address from where to get the image.

oids.name: bestLinkFlashEEPROM
oids.description: Saves the history log, eventlog, and configuration data to non-volatile memory.

oids.name: bestLinkPrimaryTimeServer
oids.description: The primary time server is responsible for sending the correct time to the UPS.

oids.name: bestLinkSecondaryTimeServer
oids.description: The secondary time server responsible for sending the correct time to the UPS.

oids.name: bestLinkSoftwareVersion
oids.description: The version of BestLink software.

oids.name: bestLinkMIBVersion
oids.description: The version of MIB implemented in SNMP/WEB Card software.

oids.name: bestLinkDHCPControl
oids.description: Enable/Disable DHCP function of SNMP/WEB Card.

oids.name: bestLinkTelnetControl
oids.description: Enable/Disable Telnet function of SNMP/WEB Card.

oids.name: bestLinkTftpControl
oids.description: Enable/Disable TFTP function of SNMP/WEB Card.

oids.name: bestLinkResetToDefault
oids.description: Reset all parameters of SNMP/WEB Card to default setting.

oids.description: Restart of SNMP/WEB Card.

oids.description: The IP address of the manager to send a trap to.

oids.name: receiverCommunityString
oids.description: The community name to use in the trap when sent to the manager.

oids.description: The severity threshold of traps to send to the manager. Traps are labeled by severity as informational(1), warning(2), severe(3). Only traps of equal or greater severity than this value are sent to...

oids.name: receiverAccept
oids.description: An entry will become active if yes, otherwise it will be disabled.

oids.name: upsRegisteredShutdownClientsIPAddress
oids.description: The IP Address of the registered shutdown client

oids.name: upsRegisteredShutdownClientsTotalNumberOf
oids.description: The total number of registered shutdown clients.

oids.name: upsConfigAutoRestart
oids.description: The status of the Auto Restart mode.

oids.name: upsConfigDelayBeforeFirstWarningMessage
oids.description: The amount of time to delay in seconds before sending the first AC Fail message.

oids.name: upsConfigWarningInterval
oids.description: The amount of time to delay in seconds between sending the additional AC Fail messages.

oids.name: upsConfigClientOperatingSystemShutdown
oids.description: Determines whether or not to initiate a shutdown of all registered clients based on the AC Fail event with duration.

oids.name: upsConfigDelayBeforeClientShutdown
oids.description: The time allowed in seconds during an AC Fail condition before shutting down of all registered clients.

oids.name: upsConfigClientOsShutdown
oids.description: Determines whether or not to initiate a shutdown of all registered clients based on the Low Battery condition.

oids.name: upsConfigShutdownUPSAfterOSShdn
oids.description: Setting this value to 1, enables the UPS to be shutdown after the registered clients operating systems have shutdown.

oids.name: upsControlTurnOffUPS
oids.description: Setting this variable to UpsOff(2) causes the UPS to shut off. When the UPS is in the off state, the UPS will remain off until the ON/OFF switch is manually toggled. Setting this variable to cancel...

oids.name: upsControlActivateUpsScheduling
oids.description: Setting this variable to On(2) causes the UPS to activate the scheduling parameters that have been previously configured within the upsConfigDailyShutdownScheduleTable and the upsConfigWeeklyShutdo...

oids.name: upsControlEnableGeneratorSensitivity
oids.description: Setting this value to a value other than (disable) begins to increase the UPS ability to reject poor line sources for example from a poorly regulated AC generator. The greater the value the greater...

oids.name: upsManualTests
oids.description: Setting this variable to any value other than (1) causes the UPS to perform a manual test or abort a particular test in progress.

oids.name: upsAlarmsPresent
oids.description: The present number of active alarm conditions.

oids.name: upsLastKnownAlarm
oids.description: A unique identifier for an alarm condition. This value must remain constant. Value 'noAlarm(37)' will be returned if no Alarm has occured till the point of GET operation.

oids.name: upsAlarmIndex
oids.description: An index of alarm entries in the alarm log.

oids.name: upsAlarmName
oids.description: A unique identifier for an alarm condition. This value must remain constant.

oids.name: upsAlarmTime
oids.description: The time that the alarm occurred in hh:mm:ss format.

oids.name: upsAlarmOnBattery
oids.description: The UPS is drawing power from the batteries.

oids.name: upsAlarmLowRuntime
oids.description: The remaining battery runtime is less than or equal to the upsConfigLowRuntimeSetpoint.

oids.name: upsAlarmNearLowBattery
oids.description: The battery voltage on the UPS has reached a value where the inverter will not be able to function very much longer.

oids.name: upsAlarmLowBattery
oids.description: The battery voltage on the UPS has reached a value where the inverter has stopped providing output power to the connected load equipment. The UPS has shutdown to protect the batteries from complete...

oids.name: upsAlarmHighBattery
oids.description: The battery charger voltage on the UPS has reached a value that is too high for safe battery maintenance.

oids.name: upsAlarmCheckBattery
oids.description: The periodic battery test has failed. A manual test of the batteries needs to be performed to determine which battery\batteries need replaced.

oids.name: upsAlarmReplaceBattery
oids.description: One or more batteries have been determined to require replacement. Compatibility: Fortress II

oids.name: upsAlarmCheckInverter
oids.description: The inverter has failed the automatic system test.

oids.name: upsAlarmBatteriesDisconnected
oids.description: The UPS has detected that the DC voltage needed to start up is too low or missing.

oids.name: upsAlarmOutputOverload
oids.description: The output load exceeds the UPS output capacity.

oids.name: upsAlarmLowAcOut
oids.description: The output load has exceeded the UPS output capacity, and the UPS has shut down.

oids.name: upsAlarmCircuitBreakerWarning
oids.description: To much load equipment has been connected to the UPS and has has caused excess current draw from the output.

oids.name: upsAlarmCircuitBreakerShdn
oids.description: The UPS has shut down due to an extended excess of current draw from the output.

oids.name: upsAlarmBypassOn
oids.description: The Bypass is presently engaged on the UPS.

oids.name: upsAlarmAutoBypass
oids.description: The UPS has gone into the Auto Bypass mode to redirect power around the UPS circuitry.

oids.name: upsAlarmSiteWiringFault
oids.description: The UPS has found a problem in your wall outlet.

oids.name: upsAlarmCheckFan
oids.description: The fan on the UPS has stopped

oids.name: upsAlarmHighAmbTemp
oids.description: The internal temperature inside the UPS is too hot.

oids.name: upsAlarmHighHSTemp
oids.description: The Inverter heatsink assembly inside the UPS is to hot .

oids.name: upsAlarmHighXFMRTemp
oids.description: The temperature of the main transformer inside the UPS is too hot .

oids.name: upsAlarmHighPFMTemp
oids.description: The temperature of the PFM module inside the UPS is too hot .

oids.name: upsAlarmProbeMissing
oids.description: One or all of the sense probes has been disconnected on the UPS.

oids.name: upsAlarmCheckPowerSupply
oids.description: The internal DC supply voltages are attenuated or missing.

oids.name: upsAlarmTapRegulator
oids.description: The UPS detected a possible failure in the tap changer (open or welded relay, etc.)

oids.name: upsAlarmRelayFailure
oids.description: There is a hardware problem inside the UPS.

oids.name: upsAlarmCheckFuse
oids.description: The failure of one or more fuses has been detected.

oids.name: upsAlarmCheckMOV
oids.description: One or more MOVs have failed due to a voltage surge.

oids.name: upsAlarmMemoryError
oids.description: The UPS has lost the programmed settings in the memory of the logic board.

oids.name: upsAlarmCallService
oids.description: A hardware malfunction has occurred inside the UPS. Please consult a factory authorized service representative for assistance.

oids.name: upsAlarmupsFailed
oids.description: A general fault in the UPS has been detected.

oids.name: upsAlarmUserTest
oids.description: A user test of the alarm beeper is in progress.

oids.name: upsAlarmTestInProgress
oids.description: A test is in progress.

oids.name: upsAlarmDiagnosticTestFailed
oids.description: The result of the last diagnostic test indicates a failure.

oids.name: upsAlarmEPO
oids.description: The Emergency Power OFF feature has been activiated at the RS-232 port on the UPS.

oids.name: upsAlarmUpsOff
oids.description: The output of the UPS is in the off state.

oids.name: upsAlarmCommunicationsLost
oids.description: A problem has been encountered in the communications between the agent and the UPS.

oids.description: The status of the bypass mode.
